theme: SIP fundamentals: power of compounding, rupee cost averaging
headline: Rupee Cost Averaging: Building Wealth Through Consistency
body: Invest fixed amounts regularly. Market ups and downs work in your favor. Time smooths out volatility.
caption: Regular investments let you buy more units when prices dip and fewer when they rise. This disciplined approach reduces emotional decision-making and harnesses market cycles. Compounding rewards patience. #SIPFundamentals #RupeeCostAveraging #InvestmentStrategy #WealthBuilding #CompoundingPower
